# Public test fixtures

`direct-waiver-verifier.json` is generated by the upstream
`direct_operator_waiver_real_proof_preserves_unknown_usage_and_signed_successor`
companion test. All keys, credentials, amounts and authorization data in it are
synthetic public test values. It contains a real Groth16 fixture authorization,
Ed25519 receipt and Baby-JubJub successor, plus malformed alternatives; it is not
a user journal or public Devnet session.

Regenerate with `ZKAPI_DIRECT_WAIVER_FIXTURE_DIR` when running that Rust test,
then copy its JSON here. `waiverBrowser.ts` is a Vite-served test harness only;
production code does not import it. It runs the installed WASM in a real Worker
and commits an isolated IndexedDB journal through the SDK's normal verifier.
